identification: Three or four mass-produced coloured royal portrait prints: an unframed colour print captioned 'His Royal Highness The Prince of Wales' (young Edward, later Edward VIII, WWI-era khaki uniform with ribbons, on large cream mount sheet, edge-worn); a small card print of Edward VIII in Highland/Scottish regimentals in a paper sleeve marked 'His Majesty King Edward VIII' (so c.1936); and a framed colour print of Princess Elizabeth in a Grenadier Guards-badge cap (captioned 'H.R.H. Princess Elizabeth', c.1940s) in a dark reeded timber frame. Decorative royal ephemera, not original art.
